title.rendered: Get tickets now for SEF’s Sip & Spell – Feb 9th

content.rendered:
Sherwood Education Foundation’s
1st Annual Sip and Spell Dinner
February 9, 2017, 6:00-9:30pm

Tickets are now available for 1st Annual Sip and Spell Dinner, sponsored by the Sherwood Education Foundation (SEF).  The event will be held at at the Sherwood Center for the Performing Arts, 6:00-9:30pm.


This fundraising event, on February 9, will feature a silent auction, dinner and local adult celebrity spelling bee – featuring teachers from several of our schools, as well as community members such as Alex Wilson from The Hungry Hero Dessert Company.   

This is a fun event for the community to get together and support our schools!  

For ticket info visit: http://www.sherwoodeducationfoundation.org/tickets/
